source.name: WBI Energy draft Resource Reports 1 and 10, FERC docket PF26-4, March 13, 2026, Figure 10.6.1-5 (GeoPDF, page 685)

resolutions.researcher_notes: Route read straight from WBI Energy's own map file. The March 13, 2026, draft filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), accession 20260313-5242, has a georeferenced map on page 685 (Figure 10.6.1-5). The whole Ellendale Lateral is drawn there as one vector line, with the preferred James River crossing that the filing says was adopted. The line was read with the map's own georeferencing, not traced by hand. It is 81.62 miles long, and the filing says 81.6. The milepost markers for miles 45 to 54 fall within 1 meter of those distances along the line. It crosses into LaMoure County at mile 30.0 and Dickey County at mile 62.1, against 29.7 and 62.1 in the filing's county table. It starts on the Bakken East mainline in Barnes County, about 14 km from Valley City, and ends about 2 km from Ellendale. This is the planned route of a lateral that was dropped from the project in April 2026 and never built.
